g01-luis-strawberries.observed_description: Luis at a market fruit stall holds up a box of strawberries and smiles at someone off the left edge.
g01-luis-strawberries.note: Gate view: Luis says I like strawberries.

g02-luis-water.observed_description: Luis in a bright living room holds out a glass of water to someone at the right edge.
g02-luis-water.note: Gate view: Would you like some water?

g03-ana-full-bag.observed_description: Ana at a vegetable stall holds a full bag of vegetables and gestures that she is finished.
g03-ana-full-bag.note: Gate view: No, that's all, thank you.

g04-diego-asks.observed_description: Diego at a cafe table with a cup of coffee looks up and asks someone off the right edge.
g04-diego-asks.note: Gate view: How much are the apples?

g05-apples-3.observed_description: A paper bag full of red apples on a cafe table behind a $3 price card.
